title: 滚石 Rolling Stone COMPASS road frameset
notes: The 2014 article attributes its product information to Rolling Stone and identifies COMPASS as a full-carbon monocoque road frameset using Japanese carbon cloth and EPS processing. It lists a horizontal aero frame, BB86, direct-mount front derailleur, mechanical/electronic shifting support, 1,060 g frame, 380 g fork, sizes 47/50/52 cm and a historical CNY 5,280 frameset/cockpit package. The historical price is not used as current market evidence.
